simple: Picus asset inventory (CAASM) (ASV): without a new scanner, it collects data from the tools you already have — Active Directory, EDR/EPP, configuration management systems, vulnerability scanners and external attack surface tools — into one list of devices, users, software, policies and vulnerabilities; you choose which source to trust first. Deploys in 2–3 hours. For every asset: network, CVEs, software, processes, services, patches and security tools; it shows computers with no security agent or with an agent that is disabled, outdated or misconfigured. Vulnerabilities from all sources are brought together and ranked by the Picus Asset Score, taking into account the results of Picus platform tests.
